about_the_game:
Echoes from Liminality is a first-person narrative exploration game that draws you into The Threshold, a strange and haunting dimension filled with echoes of the past and fragments of a life left behind. Guided by ambient soundscapes and emotionally driven puzzles, you’ll navigate uncanny environments, uncover long-buried secrets, and piece together a story that blurs the line between memory and dream.

Every step you take in this surreal world is accompanied by an evocative soundtrack that is crucial to both gameplay and storytelling. Music becomes your guide as it reveals hidden clues, triggers emotional shifts, and helps you piece together the fragmented past. It is not only the key to unraveling the mysteries of the past, but the very path that leads you toward healing and self-discovery.

At the heart of the mystery lies a missing father and the unanswered question of why he vanished. As you navigate The Threshold, you’ll confront not just the disappearance of your father, but the deeper layers of loss, identity, and connection that bind you to him. The world is alive with echoes from the past, and the choices you make will uncover the truth behind the enigmatic secrets that haunt your family.

Echoes from Liminality is not just a journey through a mysterious world, but a deeply emotional story about grief, identity, and the bonds that connect us across time and space. Prepare to step into a place that exists just outside reality… and ask yourself if you’re truly ready to confront what’s been left behind.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 590 (6 GB VRAM or more)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Wander in the Threshold, where your memories are the key. Can you face what still lingers ? An emotional story-driven exploration game in eerie liminal spaces.
